AboutDescription: A small Windows utility that starts your screensaver using idle time from the devices you choose.
AboutScope: Keyboard and mouse filtering, an independent idle timer, and manual or automatic screensaver start. Tray background operation and sign-in startup are supported. Game controllers are planned.
MonitoringOffHelp: Input activity remains visible while automatic screensaver start is paused.
